payout_quote: The State of New Jersey is offering a one-time matching grant of up to $750 for initial deposits into a new NJBEST 529 College Savings Plan. This dollar-for-dollar grant will match the first contribution made by New Jersey residents who open an NJBEST account for a new student beneficiary.
steps: Open a new NJBEST 529 account (as little as $25) for a new student beneficiary.
Make the initial deposit (matched dollar-for-dollar up to $750).
Submit the NJBEST Matching Grant application within one year of funding, attaching prior-year IRS tax return transcripts (or documented proof of income).
Keep the account open and maintain up to $750 of the initial contribution for at least three years.
catches: Account owner must be a New Jersey resident with household AGI between $0 and $75,000.
Dollar-for-dollar on the initial deposit only: deposit $25, get $25; deposit $750 or more, get $750; limited to one grant per beneficiary.
The grant application must be submitted within one year of funding the account.
Keep up to $750 of the initial contribution in the account for a minimum of three years or the matching grant is forfeited back to HESAA.
Program is subject to available funding.
Non-qualified withdrawals face federal income tax on earnings plus a 10% federal penalty - consult a tax advisor.
biggest_catch: One-time match on the initial deposit only, for NJ residents with household AGI under $75,000 - and you must leave the matched money in the account for three years or the grant is clawed back.
eligibility: New Jersey resident NJBEST (or Franklin Templeton) 529 account owner with household AGI $0-$75,000 opening an account for a new student beneficiary.
timing: One-time grant: apply within one year of funding the account; maintain the contribution for three years.
payout_value_note: Dollar-for-dollar of initial deposit; $25 minimum to open.
numeric_basis: payout from official HESAA terms ($25-$750 match); time: account opening + grant application + gathering tax transcripts, est. 30-45 min active.
